question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Merit
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Merit"** means the quality of being particularly good or worthy, especially so as to deserve praise or reward. (योग्यता)

 
 
• **Example: **She was promoted based on **merit**, not favoritism.
 
 
 
• **"Fault" **refers to an imperfection or weakness, especially one that detracts from the whole or hinders effectiveness. (दोष)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite his **faults**, he is a reliable friend.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'merit' **is **'fault'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tumult **(कोलाहल): A loud, confused noise, especially one caused by a large mass of people.

 
 
• **Example:** The** tumult **in the stadium was deafening after the winning goal.
 
 
 
• **Result **(परिणाम ): A consequence, effect, or outcome of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The **result **of the experiment was surprising.
 
 
 
• **Occult** (गुप्त): Relating to magical powers and activities, such as those of witchcraft and astrology.
 
 
• **Example:** She had a fascination with the **occult **and often read books on witchcraft.
